name: ICS_PCAPS (University of Coimbra CyberSec)
description: Collection of Modbus/TCP SCADA network traces (Modbus TCP SCADA #1) generated for ICS cybersecurity research on DoS attack detection.
relevance: Real Modbus/TCP captures usable to test CANON's HMI/PLC protocol parsing and network anomaly detection.
verification_note: WebFetch 200: repo confirmed, describes Modbus TCP SCADA #1 dataset, CC-BY-3.0/MIT license, cites Frazao et al. CRITIS 2018.

name: awesome-industrial-control-system-security
description: Curated list of ICS security resources: tools, honeypots, datasets, literature, PLC/SCADA references.
relevance: Index pointing to additional ICS datasets, honeypots and tooling relevant to CANON acquisition.
verification_note: WebFetch 200: repo confirmed, ~2000 stars, Apache-2.0, categories include Tools/Honeypots/Datasets.

name: iTrust SUTD Datasets (SWaT, WADI, EPIC, BATADAL, CISS, IoT, Blaq_0)
identifier: SUTD iTrust Centre for Research in Cyber Security
description: Official research-lab distribution of the SWaT water treatment, WADI water distribution, EPIC power, BATADAL, CISS and IoT ICS testbed datasets.
license: Provided 'as is', free for researchers; per-dataset terms of usage apply
pull_command: https://www.sutd.edu.sg/itrust/itrust-labs/datasets/  (submit dataset request form; up to 3 business days)
relevance: Gold-standard labeled ICS/SCADA testbed data (SWaT/WADI/EPIC) for validating CANON anomaly detection and HMI process modeling.
verification_note: WebFetch 200 (301 redirect from old dataset_info URL): page lists SWaT/WADI/EPIC/IoT/BATADAL/Blaq_0/CISS and states access is via formal request, up to 3 business days.

name: ICS-Security-Tools
description: Community ICS security asset with a /pcaps/ directory of industrial protocol packet captures plus protocol references and tools.
relevance: Multi-protocol ICS pcaps and tooling to exercise CANON's protocol handling and network monitoring.
verification_note: WebFetch 200: repo confirmed, ~2000 stars, CC-BY-4.0, contains dedicated /pcaps/ directory.

name: Modbus Dataset from CSET 2016
description: Labeled Modbus network traffic (normal polling, command injection, file ops, exploits) with pcaps and matching labeled CSVs from USENIX CSET 2016.
relevance: Labeled Modbus attack/benign traffic for training and benchmarking CANON intrusion detection on Modbus.
verification_note: WebFetch 200: repo confirmed (Lemay), pcap + labeled CSV files, no explicit license shown, label fix committed 2023-03-31.

name: OpenPLC Runtime v3
description: Open-source PLC runtime (industrial soft-PLC) widely used in ICS research; full source enabling Modbus/DNP3 PLC emulation. Archived 2026, successor v4.
relevance: Provides a real, controllable PLC runtime for building CANON test benches and generating realistic PLC/HMI traffic.
verification_note: WebFetch 200: repo confirmed, GPL-3.0, EOL/archived notice pointing to OpenPLC v4.

name: KitNET-py (Kitsune anomaly detector)
description: Python implementation of KitNET, an online ensemble-of-autoencoders anomaly detector (Kitsune NDSS'18), including example code and a sample dataset.
relevance: Reference unsupervised anomaly-detection algorithm plus sample data directly applicable to CANON network/sensor monitoring.
verification_note: WebFetch 200: repo confirmed, MIT (LICENSE.txt), includes KitNET.py, demo and sample dataset, 262 stars.

name: HAI (HIL-based Augmented ICS) Security Dataset
description: Time-series ICS security dataset from a HIL-augmented testbed (GE turbine, Emerson boiler, FESTO water treatment) with labeled normal/attack scenarios; versions 20.07-23.05.
relevance: Rich labeled multivariate ICS time-series for CANON anomaly detection and process-state modeling.
verification_note: WebFetch 200 + WebSearch: official repo confirmed, CC-BY-SA-4.0, CSV with timestamped columns, git lfs for 22.04+, also on Kaggle.

name: Tommy Morris ICS Cyber Attack Datasets (gas pipeline, water storage)
description: Widely-cited labeled RTU/Modbus telemetry from lab-scale gas pipeline and water storage tank systems with attack and normal behavior (Datasets 3 and 4).
relevance: Classic gas-pipeline/water-tank ICS attack telemetry for benchmarking CANON detection on serial/Modbus SCADA data.
verification_note: WebFetch 200: page confirmed, provides direct download links (ARFF/TXT, 10% samples), no explicit license, requests citation.

name: IPAL Datasets (conversion scripts for 20+ ICS datasets)
description: Scripts converting 20+ industrial datasets (Electra, Lemay, MorrisDS, QUT_DNP3/S7, SWaT, WADI, HAI, BATADAL, TEP-PASAD, PowerDuck, WDT) into the unified IPAL format. Does not host raw data.
relevance: Unifying loader/normalizer across many ICS datasets, accelerating CANON dataset ingestion; also serves as index of source datasets.
verification_note: WebFetch 200: repo confirmed (Fraunhofer FKIE/RWTH Aachen), MIT, lists 20+ packet- and state-based datasets; notes raw data must be obtained from original sources.

name: Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB)
description: Benchmark of 50+ labeled real-world and synthetic streaming time-series with anomaly windows and a scoring framework for real-time anomaly detection.
license: AGPL-3.0 (repo LICENSE; WebFetch summary reported MIT - verify LICENSE file)
relevance: Standard streaming-anomaly benchmark and scoring for validating CANON sensor-stream anomaly detectors.
verification_note: WebFetch 200: repo confirmed, 58 labeled CSV series + JSON windows, scoring tools; license reported as MIT by summarizer but NAB LICENSE is AGPL-3.0 - flagged for manual confirmation.

name: Beremiz
description: Free IEC-61131-3 machine-automation IDE conforming to PLCopen TC6-XML; includes example projects (tests/projects, examples) in ST and PLCopen XML.
relevance: Source of real PLCopen XML / IEC 61131-3 ST sample projects for CANON PLC-program parsing and HMI logic modeling.
verification_note: WebFetch 200: repo confirmed, IEC-61131 IDE with PLCopen TC6-XML schema, example dirs tests/projects and examples, GPL/LGPL licenses.

name: awesome-structured-text

relevance: Index of PLC/IEC 61131-3 ST tooling and code sources feeding CANON's PLC-code corpus discovery.
